final: WITH li AS (SELECT order_item_id, product_price * 1.0 / NULLIF(derived_total_cost, 0) AS ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items), per_item AS (SELECT order_item_id, AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS n_lines FROM li GROUP BY order_item_id) SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall_avg_ratio, AVG(n_lines) AS avg_lines_per_order_item FROM per_item
